attchmntText: Landmark Cars Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Proposed investments in Wholly Owned Subsidiaries'.
voiceSummary: Landmark Cars Limited approved its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a consolidated profit after tax of 184.88 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 15.02 million for the same period in 2025. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the profit after tax was 330.34 million, versus 88.68 million in the prior year. Revenue from operations stood at 14,516.08 million for the quarter and 27,539.66 million for the half year. The Board also approved an additional investment of up to 25,00,00,000 rupees each in wholly owned subsidiaries Landmark Luxury Retail Private Limited and Landmark Automotive Private Limited. The total investment cost is 50.00 Crores. The results are subject to limited review by statutory auditors.

attchmntText: Landmark Cars Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Landmark Cars Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Proforma revenue for Q2FY27 was Rs. 19,457 Mn, up 17.4% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at Rs. 862 Mn, a 45.7% increase. Profit after tax was Rs. 185 Mn, rising 1130.9%. For H1FY27, proforma revenue reached Rs. 36,781 Mn, up 19.7%. EBITDA was Rs. 1,614 Mn, up 28.8%. Profit after tax was Rs. 330 Mn, up 272.5%. The company operates 143 outlets across 29 cities. It holds a 16.1% market share in Mercedes-Benz sales. The EV portfolio contributed approximately 29% of new car sales revenue in H1FY27. The company unveiled Denza Cars on November 13, 2026. It received a letter of intent from JSW Motors.
